integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically. Exact finite enumeration is used only as a sanity check. Literature comparison distinguishes qualitative Schur concavity and component-wise majorization from the metric quadratic remainder.
scientific_limitations: For dimensions greater than two the remainder coefficient is not claimed optimal; the result controls amplitude only and uses the finite-field endpoint fiber identity.
title: Quadratic stability for endpoint finite-field moment-curve extension
